task.objective: Replace with the machine learning objective.

prediction_artifact.format: Replace with the artifact format consumed by the evaluator.

ranking_policy.domain_convention: Replace with raw mean, lower confidence bound, Pareto, robust composite, or task-specific rule.
ranking_policy.frontier_axis_notes: If robustness matters, add lower-bound/std/risk axes to evaluation.frontier_lanes.

evaluator.preliminary_mode: Replace with the smallest safe evaluator mode for wiring/failure triage only.
evaluator.aligned_mode: Replace with the fixed aligned protocol used for prioritization before complete evaluation.
evaluator.complete_mode: Replace with the complete evaluator mode.

reduce_first: fixed repeated restarts or checkpoint sweeps
reduce_evaluation_units_only_if_unavoida: stratified coverage of all major regimes

evidence.confirmed: Complete-evaluation result with complete metric evidence.
evidence.incubator: Lower-admission durable long-term library for task-authorized, protocol-passed, non-suspect Pareto/new-high variants that need follow-up before clean confirmation.
evidence.task_candidate: Promising immature result that needs follow-up.
evidence.diagnostic: Control, failure, invalid-output, or process evidence.
